{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
print(df.head())
print(df.info())

# Check for the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Convert revenue to float after stripping commas
# First, ensure all revenue entries are strings and strip commas
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Drop the QA orders
df_clean = df_clean = df[~(df['revenue'] == '999999.99')]

# Check status: only 'completed' should count toward conversion
# Drop 'refunded' orders
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Verify the final dataset
print(f"Final dataset shape: {df_clean.shape}")
print(f"Channel distribution:")
print(df_clean['channel'].value_counts())
print(f"Customer segment distribution:")
print(df_clean['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check if channel and customer_segment are confounded
print("Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:")
print(pd.crosstab(df_clean['channel'], df_clean['customer_segment']))"}
